key_value: Shows that conditional diffusion has already entered probabilistic charging-load forecasting.

title: Federated Graph Learning for EV Charging Demand Forecasting with Personalization Against Cyberattacks
key_value: Closest frontier reference for personalized federated graph forecasting and adversarial trust.
known_limitation: Preprint; threat model and reproducibility need verification.

code_url: repository linked from preprint; verify before pinning
key_value: Recent direct reference for privacy-preserving early charging-demand prediction.
known_limitation: Preprint and code link must be independently verified.

title: Measuring Flexibility through Reduction Potential

known_limitation: Preprint and not necessarily a forecasting method.
